selection.review_filter: both episodes have review_status=complete and segments=[]

method: CPU recomposition of the original 50 fps RGB exports; every second real source frame is sampled. No optical-flow interpolation or duplication to fake the frame rate.

output.short_input_behavior: Hold the actual final source frame until the shared phase boundary; no action acceleration.

flatten.terminal_hold_rule: Repeated terminal hold starts only after the real source clip ends; the last genuine sample remains part of the original action.
